title: OFAC Sanctions Screening with AI Agents: The SDN List, Fuzzy Matching, and the 50 Percent Rule
summary: Sanctions screening is strict-liability and the SDN list does not match cleanly. How we architect AI agents for name and identifier screening, beneficial-ownership traversal under the 50 percent rule, and hit disposition that survives an OFAC subpoena.
